core.title: TC7700 Series Global Concealed Overhead Door Closer (Kawneer Husky)

text.description_html:
TC7700 Series Global Concealed Overhead Door Closer (Kawneer Husky Door Closer "Shotgun")

The TC7700 series replaces the original Kawneer Husky "Shotgun" concealed overhead closer model. This new version Husky Door Closer features a two-speed closing control to prevent the door from slamming against the stop on single-acting applications. It also prevents over-swing on double-acting applications.

The TC7700 is an ideal choice for schools, office buildings, hospitals, department stores and any other facilities that demand reliability for interior and exterior doors.

Closing Speed Adjustment Tip: Through the first 80 degrees of the closing cycle, the door should be kept at a moderate speed to prevent heel bumping as someone enters through an out-swing door. Additional adjusting information on closing speed and latching speed can be found on the instruction sheet that comes packaged with the TC7700.

Available in 3 Spring tensions: Light #3, Medium #4, and Heavy #5. All available with Non-Hold Open or Hold Open feature.

Features of Husky Door Closers

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Swing: Optional 90 or 105 degrees
  • Non Handed
  • Double Acting (Door can swing both ways)
  • Optional Non-Hold Open or Hold Open options
  • 1 Year Manufacturer's Warranty
  • Husky Adjustment and Installation Instructions (PDF)

Specifications for Light #3:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 155 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" interior / 30" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-623: (Discontinued) #3 Non-Hold Open, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-624: (Discontinued) #3 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-625: (Discontinued) #3 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-626: (Discontinued) #3 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop

Specifications for Medium #4:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 243 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 44" interior / 36" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-627: (Discontinued) #4 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-628: (Discontinued) #4 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-629: (Discontinued) #4 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop

Specifications for Heavy #5:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 375 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Kawneer# 37-630: (Discontinued) #5 Non-Hold Open, 105 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-631: (Discontinued) #5 Hold Open 90 Degrees, 90 Degree Back Stop
  • Kawneer# 37-632: (Discontinued) #5 Hold Open 105 Degrees, 105 Degree Back Stop
